organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found satisfactory.

2. PERFORMANCE ASSESSMENT
Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was cooperative, with weekly progress reporting maintained without prompting, and .
On that basis the agency may be invited for future tenders in this category.

3. RECOMMENDATION
National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. completed the engagement within the sanctioned time and cost, and their conduct on site was
professional throughout. We would consider them for similar works.
We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in the future. This reference is valid
for a period of High from the date of this letter.
4. VERIFICATION
For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter is issued upon specific request of the
contractor and does not constitute any commitment or guarantee for future engagements.
